```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-align: 'center'
#| warning: false
#| message: false


# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
data <- read.csv(("data/student_depression.csv"))
# Data preparation
df <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = as.numeric(factor(Gender)),
    City = as.numeric(factor(City)),
    Profession = as.numeric(factor(Profession)),
    Dietary.Habits = as.numeric(factor(Dietary.Habits)),
    Degree = as.numeric(factor(Degree)),
    Suicidal_Thoughts = as.numeric(factor(Have.you.ever.had.suicidal.thoughts..)),
    Financial.Stress = as.numeric(factor(Financial.Stress)),
    Family.History = as.numeric(factor(Family.History.of.Mental.Illness)),
    Sleep.Duration = as.numeric(factor(Sleep.Duration))
  ) %>%
  select_if(is.numeric)

# Calculate correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(df, use = "complete.obs")

# Create the heatmap
ggcorrplot(cor_matrix,
           hc.order = TRUE,
           type = "lower",
           lab = TRUE,
           lab_size = 4.5,
           method = "square",
           colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"),
           tl.cex = 14,  # Text label size
           ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
```
